**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

Section 18 fully satisfies the preferred INSURANCE position:
- **§18.1 (p0073):** CGL USD 1M/occurrence and USD 2M aggregate; workers' compensation as required by law plus employer's liability USD 1M; professional E&O USD 2M; cyber and privacy liability USD 5M — held throughout the term and for one year afterward. Cyber at USD 5M is appropriate since Vendor hosts and processes Customer Data.
- **§18.2 (p0074):** reputable insurers, primacy where customary, certificates of insurance on request, notice of cancellation/material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities (which preserves the §21 cap analysis).

This exceeds the fallback (E&O 1M / cyber 2M) and requires no changes.
